item.title: Tori Amos Unveils New Song "Shush" About "Lizard-Demon" Billionaire
item.description: Tori Amos has released "Shush," a politically-charged new song and the latest single from her upcoming new album In Times of Dragons.

item.title: Willie Nelson Announces Dates for 2026 Outlaw Music Festival Tour
item.description: Willie Nelson has announced dates for his announced the 2026 Outlaw Music Festival summer tour, featuring Wilco, The Avett Brothers, Sheryl Crow, and more.

item.title: JAY-Z Explains Why Not All Billionaires Are Bad
item.description: In a new interview with GQ, JAY-Z spoke about the criticism that millionaires and billionaires receive and why he doesn't believe "your morality is not defined by a dollar amount."

item.title: For All Mankind Renewed for Sixth and Final Season by Apple TV
item.description: TBD on whether a 90-something Ed Baldwin will continue to voyage the stars.

item.title: Future Islands Announce New Compilation Album to Celebrate 20th Anniversary
item.description: Future Islands announced From a Hole in the Floor to a Fountain of Youth, a new compilation album, and dropped new songs "Sail" and "Find Love."

item.title: Slash & Duff McKagan Reunite with Ex-GN'R Members Steven Adler & Gilby Clarke at Benefit Gig
item.description: Slash and Duff McKagan reunited with former Guns N' Roses members Steven Adler and Gilby Clarke at the "Rock for Jennifer - Loud and Legendary" benefit concert.

item.title: Flea Covers Frank Ocean's "Thinkin Bout You" on Fallon
item.description: Flea stopped by The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon to perform his cover of Frank Ocean's "Thinkin Bout You," which appears on his upcoming album Honora.

item.title: JAY-Z Thinks Kendrick Lamar and Drake's Rap Beef Went "Too Far"
item.description: JAY-Z has said Kendrick Lamar and Drake's rap beef went "too far," questioning if battling is still a necessary pillar of hip-hop culture.

item.title: Original Deftones Bassist Kicked Out of Band's Show for "Being Too Aggressive in the Pit"
item.description: Original Deftones bassist Dominic Garcia recently went to see his former band play a hometown gig in Sacramento, California, and was kicked out of the show.

item.title: Pixies Announce 2026 US Tour
item.description: Pixies have announced a brief US tour taking place in September 2026 in celebration of their 40th anniversary as a band.
